messages.subject: For SUEZ executive leadership | Government relations, infrastructure and sustainability
messages.body:
Dear SUEZ Media and Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before the appropriate member of SUEZ senior leadership.

SUEZ operates where regulated infrastructure, public institutions, environmental performance and community expectations meet. That operating environment closely matches my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior engagement across ministries, regulators, communities and operating teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of institutional engagement, sustainability execution and stakeholder leadership could support SUEZ across international markets. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to SUEZ.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
